svg.title: Spectral ribbon: five rhythm bands, light appearance
svg.desc: Original vector illustration. Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta and Gamma with the app frequency intervals and selected overlapping EEG associations. Normalized sine waves are schematic, not EEG recordings or predicted effects of listening. All lettering is original geometric paths; no external images, icons or fonts.
